project_title: CodeLab / LeetCode Platform Architecture & Design System
target_audience: Developers, Computer Science Students, Competitive Programmers, Tech Job Seekers

problems_list_page.type: High Density Data Grid & Filter Bar
sections: Header Navigation with logo, Search input, Dark/Light Mode toggle, User Profile Avatar / Login CTA
Hero Banner / Daily Challenge Card (Gradient border, animated progress, streak count)
Filters Bar: Search query input, Tag badges (Array, String, Dynamic Programming, Graph, Hash Table), Difficulty tabs (All, Easy, Medium, Hard), Status dropdown (Solved, Unsolved, Attempted)
Problems Data Table: Status icon, Problem Title + ID, Companies tags, Acceptance Rate %, Difficulty Badge, Solved Checkmark
Pagination / Stats Footer: Showing total solved, total problems, items per page dropdown

problem_workspace_page.type: Resizable Split Pane View (Left Description/Submissions - Right Code Editor & Console)

left_pane.description_content: Title, Difficulty Badge, Tags, Company Chips, Problem Statement (formatted with code samples, constraints bullet list, example boxes with Inputs & Outputs, complexity requirements)

right_pane.top_bar: Language selector (Java, Python, C++, JavaScript), Theme settings modal, Auto-save indicator, Reset Code button, Fullscreen toggle
right_pane.editor: Monaco style code view with syntax highlighting, line numbers, autocomplete boilerplate code templates per language

tabs: Test Result (Outputs, Expected vs Actual, Runtime ms, Memory MB)
bottom_console.action_bar: Console collapse toggle, Run Code button (guest enabled), Submit Solution button (requires Auth trigger if logged out)

auth_modal_and_page.type: Interactive Dialog / Modal & Dedicated Auth Page
providers: Mobile OTP (Labelled with 'Coming Soon' tag or interactive step)
auth_modal_and_page.guest_behavior: Non-authenticated users can view problems, edit code, execute 'Run Code' testcases. Clicking 'Submit Solution' or 'Profile' triggers the Auth Modal with a clear tooltip/toast alert.

cards: User Identity Card (Avatar, Username, Rank badge, Join Date, Streak Counter)
Solved Breakdown Radial Ring Chart (Easy/Medium/Hard progress counts vs total)
Submissions Heatmap Graph (52-week green activity grid similar to LeetCode/GitHub)
Language Proficiency Progress Bars (Java, Python, JavaScript, C++ usage %)
Recent Submissions Log Table (Problem Name, Language, Status: Accepted/Wrong Answer, Time Ago)

shadcn_components_used: Resizable (for split view left/right & editor/console vertical split)
DropdownMenu (for language selection & user avatar menu)
Sonner (for notifications like 'Run code success', 'Please login to submit')
custom_elements: Custom Code Editor component with syntax highlighting

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Ensure dark/light mode toggle works flawlessly across all pages using standard Tailwind dark class on html container.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select/input elements. Use Shadcn components and custom styled borders.
Ensure non-logged-in users can navigate, view problem statements, write code in editor, change languages, and click 'Run Code' to see console outputs.
When non-logged-in user clicks 'Submit Solution' or attempts to access Profile, prompt Auth Dialog with Sonner notification.
All interactive elements MUST contain appropriate data-testid attributes specified in data_testid_requirements.
Ensure Monaco/CodeEditor container is responsive and fills remaining height properly without overflowing page body.
